viewerSpike.title: Viewer extraction spike
viewerSpike.heading: Track viewer extraction spike (issue #859)
viewerSpike.intro: This page renders the standalone @trackdraw/viewer package (packages/viewer/src) with no editor store, next-intl, or app chrome involved — only a design object is passed in as a prop. To manually compare against the existing editor viewer, open the same fixture designs in the editor via the JSON import flow (see fixtures.ts for the raw shapes).
viewerSpike.simulateNoWebgl: Simulate unsupported WebGL on instance A (should fall back to 2D only, 3D toggle hidden)
viewerSpike.instanceAHeading: Instance A — multi-org design, light theme, imperial units
viewerSpike.instanceBHeading: Instance B — distinct design, dark theme, metric units (isolation check: should never show instance A's shapes)
viewerSpike.instanceCHeading: Instance C — same design as A, served under a non-root asset prefix ({prefix})
viewerSpike.instanceCDescription: Textures for this instance resolve through a rewrite rule in next.config.ts that maps {prefix}/assets/:path* back to /assets/:path* — check the Network tab to confirm every texture request for the MultiGP obstacles actually goes out under this prefix instead of the root path.
